name: gridcheck_methyl
purpose: TASKS 156 (c) (the user, 3 Nov: 'begin met 156(c)'): is the methyl class's NOISY flag grid noise like styrene's vinyl? Imidazole+CH3's 15 Hessians (reference and the +- displacements of its seven worst modes) at grid 99/590 against S2's 75/302, read by probes/qff_grid_recheck.py and probes/s2_gridcheck_methyl_read.py under the rule in its docstring

estimate.basis: S2 computed imidazole+CH3's 61 Hessians at 75/302 in 110 min on 5 threads (1.8 min each); 99/590 takes about twice the grid points, 15 Hessians

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 6144 MB; imidazole+CH3 has 12 atoms in 6-31G*
